Material r eceived without the mandatory documents specified below shall not be permitted entry int o the plant premises. A. Contract copy. B. GeM invoice and GST tax invoice copy. Through the representation window for rejected bidders, a bidder can submit thei r representation regarding a wrong evaluation of their bids. 8.
